admin.billing_coverage.title: Billing coverage
admin.billing_coverage.intro: Active subscriptions and upcoming Mondays: paid charges, pending attempts, and weeks the scheduler would charge next. Use “Charge” only when you intend a manual SumUp checkout for that week.
admin.billing_coverage.table_caption: Billing coverage by subscription and week
admin.billing_charge.modal_body: This creates a payment attempt and SumUp checkout for the subscription and fulfillment week (Monday):
admin.billing_charge.confirm_checkbox: I confirm triggering a manual charge for this subscription and week.
admin.billing_charge.flash_started: Manual charge started; watch payment status in the payments list.
admin.billing_charge.flash_failed: Charge could not be completed. Check logs and payment list.
admin.billing_charge.validation_missing_: Subscription has no saved payment method (SumUp token).
admin.billing_charge.validation_subscrip: Subscription is paused for this week.
admin.billing_charge.validation_pending_: Resolve or wait for the latest pending payment before charging again.
admin.box_planner.title: Weekly box planner
admin.box_planner.intro: Active subscriptions across upcoming weeks: create boxes, compare catalog sum to subscription budget, and run fills only after preview + confirm. Cells that are not deliverable (pause or plan cadence) are marked.
admin.box_planner.table_caption: Weekly box planner by subscription and Monday week start
admin.box_planner.legend_canonical_body: Weekly menu per size: one identical product list for all subscriptions of the same box size (default greedy list under the cap; editable on the preview page before apply).
admin.box_planner.legend_distribute_body: Rotate catalog: deterministic round-robin across households for the week (see preview page).
admin.box_planner.legend_docs_hint: Details: docs/ADMIN-BOX-PLANNER.md and docs/ADMIN-EQUAL-DISTRIBUTION.md in the repository.
admin.box_planner.trial_budget_notice: First billing cycle may use the trial TTC until the first paid recurring payment is confirmed — effective budget can differ from the size price.
admin.box_planner.planning_margin_hint: The after-margin hint uses :percent % from config/box.php (display only, does not block).
admin.box_planner.over_budget_detail_not: Catalog sum exceeds the subscription budget — shipping is still allowed; decide consciously.
admin.box_planner.flash_canonical_applie: Weekly menu per size applied to :count box(es).
admin.box_planner.flash_box_exists: A box for this week already exists.
admin.box_planner.validation_week_monday: The date must be a Monday.
admin.box_planner.validation_not_eligibl: No box is scheduled for this week (pause or plan cadence).
admin.box_planner.validation_subscriptio: This subscription does not match the box owner.
admin.box_fill_canonical.preview_title: Preview: weekly menu per box size
admin.box_fill_canonical.preview_intro: One shared list per box size; cap = lowest subscription budget in that group (TTC incl. add-ons). Week starting :date (Monday).
admin.box_fill_canonical.no_blocks: Nothing to show for this week.
admin.box_fill_canonical.same_lines_hint: The same lines are copied to every subscription of this size.
admin.box_fill_canonical.no_template_lin: No lines fit under the cap.
admin.box_fill_canonical.confirm_body: Core lines are replaced for all editable boxes of the week, per size, with the list shown. Shop extras stay.
admin.box_fill_canonical.edit_hint: Adjust quantities, remove lines, or add products from the catalog below; the same lines apply to every subscription of that size.
admin.box_fill_canonical.validation_prod: The product is not available in the catalog.
admin.box_fill_canonical.banner_over_pla: At least one line would exceed the weekly planned stock. Apply is still allowed — decide consciously or adjust the weekly catalog.

admin.weekly_catalog.help: Set the available products and quantities per week. New products can be created inline.

admin.weekly_catalog.validation_duplicat: This product is already listed for the week.
admin.box_distribute.title: Equal catalog distribution to boxes
admin.box_distribute.intro: Preview for the week starting :date (Monday). Core lines (non-shop extras) will be replaced; catalog supply is unlimited in MVP (no stock field yet).
admin.box_distribute.no_targets: No editable boxes for this week.
admin.box_distribute.confirm_body: All core lines (is_extra = false) in the boxes above will be removed and re-filled from the catalog using round-robin. Shop extras stay.
admin.box_distribute.confirm_checkbox: Yes, replace core lines and apply equal distribution
admin.box_distribute.flash_applied: Equal distribution applied: :updated box(es) updated, :skipped skipped (locked/delivered).
